title: Verify successful registration with valid details
description: Register a new account using a unique, valid email address and a compliant password, and verify the account is created successfully.

title: Verify registration rejected for duplicate email
description: Attempt to register a new account using an email address that is already registered and verify the system blocks it with a clear error.

title: Verify registration fails with invalid email format
description: Attempt to register using a malformed email address and verify the system rejects the input with a validation error.

title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
description: Log in using a valid registered email address and correct password and verify the user reaches their account dashboard.

title: Verify login rejected with incorrect password
description: Attempt to log in using a valid email but an incorrect password and verify the system displays a clear error message.

title: Verify login rejected with unregistered username
description: Attempt to log in using an email address that is not registered and verify the system displays a clear error message.

title: Verify password reset email is sent
description: Request a password reset for a registered email address and verify a reset email is sent to that address.

title: Verify password reset link expires
description: Request a password reset, wait past the link's validity window, and verify the expired link can no longer be used.

title: Verify new account requires email verification
description: Register a new account and verify the user cannot fully access the system until the verification link is confirmed.

title: Verify unverified account access is restricted
description: Attempt to access restricted account features before completing email verification and verify access is denied.

title: Verify account locks after failed login attempts
description: Attempt to log in with an incorrect password five consecutive times and verify the account becomes locked.

title: Verify locked account cannot log in with correct password
description: After an account is locked, attempt to log in using the correct password and verify access is still denied.

title: Verify session expires after inactivity
description: Log in successfully, remain inactive for 30 minutes, and verify the session has expired and requires re-authentication.

title: Verify password meets complexity requirements
description: Attempt to set a password that meets the minimum length and character variety requirements and verify it is accepted.

title: Verify weak password rejected during registration
description: Attempt to register using a password that does not meet the minimum complexity rules and verify it is rejected.

title: Verify user can update profile display name
description: Update the display name and contact details in the user profile settings and verify the changes are saved.

title: Verify admin pages blocked for standard role
description: Log in as a standard (non-admin) user and attempt to access an administrative page, verifying access is denied.

title: Verify logout terminates active session
description: Log out of an active session and verify the session is terminated and protected pages are no longer accessible.

title: Verify password field masks input characters
description: Type into the password field during login and verify the characters are masked on screen as they are entered.

title: Verify terms and conditions checkbox is displayed
description: Open the registration page and verify a terms and conditions checkbox is displayed and must be checked to proceed.
